name: v3_hppo_paper_protocol
paper_title_working: Feasibility-Aware Hybrid PPO for Fixed-Route Electric Vehicle Charging

proposed_method.name: Feasibility-Aware Hybrid PPO
proposed_method.definition: Hybrid discrete-continuous PPO with energy-continuation SOC lower bound, optimistic time-feasibility SOC upper bound, and one global TRAIN-only return scale
proposed_method.soc_mapping: SOC_target = SOC_lower + u * (SOC_upper - SOC_lower), u in [0,1]

relationship_to_prior_stages.v2: historical frozen HybridPPO/DiscretePPO experiment under results/v2/final/; preserved intact; not the confirmatory experiment for this paper
relationship_to_prior_stages.v3_hppo: paper-facing confirmatory protocol centered solely on FA-HPPO

reused_checkpoints.selection: parent-balanced VAL feasibility then completion on SynthCharge VAL
reused_checkpoints.note: Checkpoints were frozen before V2 TEST and are reused without reselection for V3. No DiscretePPO checkpoints enter V3 evaluation.

hypotheses_predeclared: H1: FA-HPPO achieves higher route feasibility than each of GreedyMinimumSufficientCharge, GreedyFullCharge, and OneStepLookahead on the fresh V3 SynthCharge TEST.
H2: FA-HPPO achieves lower failure-retaining completion time than each of those three baselines on the same TEST.
H3 (development): On gold TRAIN/VAL, B2 improves parent-balanced feasibility relative to B0/B1/B3 (descriptive five-seed ablation; not TEST).
H4 (development, amount): Forcing u=0 (Min) or u=1 (Max) at evaluation on frozen FA-HPPO checkpoints does not dominate free continuous amount choice on the V3 TEST primary metrics.

confirmatory_test.seed_range_audit: existing SynthCharge seeds max at 300550; 400000+ unused

primary_metrics: failure-retaining completion (infeasible -> depot due date H)

statistics.learned_summary: mean and SD across five training seeds
statistics.uncertainty: 95% hierarchical bootstrap resampling training seed then base_instance/route
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm within the six-comparison primary family

development_ablation.label: development/validation ablation, not fresh TEST evidence
development_ablation.note: Existing two-seed V2 diagnostics remain historical; five-seed runs supersede them for the paper ablation table when completed.

amount_ablations.FA-HPPO-Min: same frozen HybridPPO discrete station policy; force u=0 (lower SOC bound) at evaluation
amount_ablations.FA-HPPO-Max: same frozen HybridPPO discrete station policy; force u=1 (upper SOC bound) at evaluation
amount_ablations.implementation: evaluation wrappers only; no retraining; no src changes

native_frvcp_reference.role: native FRVCP reference, not exact EVRPTW-GR oracle

stopping_rules.quota_shortfall: STOP and report; do not relax parameters
